Texts.LongWelcomeMessage: Welcome to the application. This is a startup project based on the ABP framework. For more information visit
Texts.Permission:DbExplorer.Edit: Edit data in the DB explorer
Texts.Jobs:Title: Background jobs
Texts.Jobs:Intro: The queue that runs monitoring alerts and password recovery links. A failing job retries on its own with increasing waits and is abandoned after two days; without this screen, all of that happens silently.
Texts.Jobs:Empty: There are no jobs in the queue.
Texts.Jobs:EmptyHint: Completed jobs are kept for three days, so a completely empty queue can also mean nothing has been queued recently.
Texts.Jobs:LoadError: Could not load the job queue.
Texts.Jobs:ConfirmDelete: Remove "{0}" from the queue? It will not run again. Its failure history is kept.
Texts.Notifications:Intro: What the application wanted to tell you: monitoring rules that fired, automatic blocks and jobs that were abandoned. Each notice links to the screen where it is fixed.
Texts.Sessions:Intro: Where your session is open right now. If you see something you do not recognise, close it and change your password.
Texts.Sessions:Empty: No sessions recorded. Sign in again so this one shows up.
Texts.Sessions:Hint: Closing a session cuts its access on the next request. API keys are not sessions: they are revoked from their own screen.
Texts.ApiKeys:Intro: They let a script or a scheduled task call the API without a browser.
Texts.ApiKeys:WarnAuth: second factor. Treat it like a password.
Texts.ApiKeys:WarnOnce: and cannot show it to you again. If you lose it, revoke it and create another.
Texts.ApiKeys:ExpiryHint: Setting an expiry is the sensible thing: a key with no date lives until someone remembers it exists.
Texts.ApiKeys:Empty: You do not have any keys yet.
Texts.SystemStatus:Intro: What used to take five screens and two server timers. It refreshes on its own every minute.
Texts.SystemStatus:RestoreHint: Restores the remote backup into a temporary database. It is the only thing that proves the backup works, and not just that it was uploaded.
Texts.SystemStatus:UptimeHint: A very low uptime means the service restarted recently.
Texts.SystemStatus:CountsHint: Counts only. The detail of each item is on its own screen, with its own permission.
Texts.SystemStatus:Title: System status
Texts.SystemStatus:NeedsReview: Something needs a look. Marked in red or amber below.
Texts.ApiKeys:SentInHeader: It is sent in the header
Texts.Common:Name: Name
Texts.Security:Intro: IPs banned from the application. This is not rate limiting: that counts requests per minute and forgets on every deploy; this lasts until it is removed.
Texts.Security:CannotBlockSelf: You cannot block your own address: you would lose access to this very screen.
Texts.Security:LogIntro: Who tried to get in, from where, and whether they made it. ABP writes this itself; here it is only read.
Texts.Metrics:Title: Server metrics
Texts.Metrics:NoSamples: No samples yet. The collector takes one a minute: come back in a while.
Texts.Metrics:StaleTail: . The charts below do not reflect the current state.
Texts.AuditLogs:Title: Request log
Texts.AuditLogs:Empty: No requests recorded in this range.
Texts.Metrics:SendWhenOutOfRange: Send alerts when something goes out of range
Texts.Metrics:BotTokenHint: Stored encrypted and never leaves the database again. Leave it empty to keep the current one.
Texts.Metrics:ChatIdHint: Several separated by commas. Group ones start with
Texts.Metrics:ChatIdHint2: . To find yours, message your bot and open
Texts.EntityChanges:Title: Change history
Texts.EntityChanges:Intro: Who changed which field, and from what value to what. A short list of entities is tracked on purpose: tracking them all would fill the audit log with server metrics.
Texts.EntityChanges:NoFields: No fields recorded for this change.
Texts.EntityChanges:Empty: No changes recorded with those filters.
Texts.Telegram:Intro1: Link your account with Telegram so you can
Texts.Telegram:Intro2: . It is used for system alerts and the second factor at sign-in.
Texts.Telegram:NoResponse: No response from the server. Reload the page; if it stays the same, check the browser console.
Texts.Telegram:NoBot: No Telegram bot configured yet. Set it up on the page of
Texts.Telegram:NoBot2: , under «Telegram alerts», and come back here.
Texts.Telegram:AskCode: Ask for a Telegram code when signing in
Texts.Telegram:TwoFactorOn: Enabled. Every time you sign in we will send you a 6-digit code through Telegram.
Texts.Telegram:TwoFactorOff: Disabled. Your password alone is enough to get into your account.
Texts.Telegram:UnlinkWarn: If you unlink, you will no longer receive system alerts and sign-in codes through Telegram
Texts.Telegram:UnlinkWarn2: and the second factor will be switched off
Texts.Telegram:LinkSteps: Generate a link, open it in Telegram and press «Start». The bot will confirm that it is linked.
Texts.Telegram:DoNotShare: Do not share it with anyone
Texts.Telegram:DoNotShare2: : whoever opens this link will link their Telegram to your account and will be able to receive your recovery link.
Texts.Telegram:Waiting: Waiting for you to open the link…
Texts.ProfilePicture:Hint: JPG, PNG or WebP. The image is cropped to a square in the top bar, so a centred face works best.
Texts.DbExplorer:Intro: Administration tool. Reads every table; edits only the application tables. It skips domain validation, auditing and ABP filters.
Texts.ApiKeys:NeedName: Give it a name: in six months it will be the only thing saying what it is for.
Texts.Security:NeedIpAndReason: The IP and the reason are required.
Texts.SystemStatus:LoadError: Could not load the system status.
Texts.Branding:Title: Branding
Texts.Branding:Intro: The name, logo and colour every user of this organisation will see, including on the sign-in page.
Texts.Branding:HostWarning: You are editing as the installation administrator: what you save here is what every tenant without its own settings will see.
Texts.Branding:NameHint: Shown in the side menu and in the browser tab. Leave it empty to inherit the installation one.
Texts.Branding:ColorHint: Used for the active menu entry, primary buttons and interface details, including on the sign-in page.
Texts.Branding:LogoHint: PNG, JPG or WebP. Stored scaled down to {0} pixels and keeping transparency, so a PNG with a transparent background looks best on the dark side menu.
Texts.Branding:NotAnImage: That file could not be read as an image. Try a PNG or a JPG.
Texts.Tenants:Title: Tenants
Texts.Tenants:Intro: Each tenant gets its own space, with its own sign-in, users and branding. Creating one produces a link so they can set up their own administrator.
Texts.Tenants:Name: Name
Texts.Tenants:LinkWarning: Copy it now and hand it to that organisation: it is not shown again. If you lose it, generate another.
Texts.Activate:Title: Create your administrator
Texts.Activate:Intro: You are activating the space for {0}. This user will be the administrator and will be able to create the rest.
Texts.Activate:PasswordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
Texts.Activate:DoneHint: You can now sign in with the user name and password you just chose.
Texts.Activate:UnusableHint: It may have been used already or expired. Ask for a new one from whoever gave it to you.
Texts.Permission:Tenants.Impersonate: Sign in as a tenant administrator
Texts.Suplantacion:Aviso: You are viewing this space as its administrator. Your real account is {0}.
Texts.ProfilePicture:Intro: Your picture appears in the top bar. It is stored resized to {0} pixels, so you don't need to look for a small one.
Texts.Mesas:Intro: Your dining room tables. Only visible if your organisation has the restaurant module.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:CredencialesSinConsenti: Confirm the client authorized the firm to keep their credentials before saving them.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:PataSinDato: To link it, the UUID, the reference or the document is missing.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:SolicitudSinResolver: Say whether the request was handled or rejected.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:SolicitudRechazadaSinMo: To reject a request, say why.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:UuidNoValido: That UUID is not valid: 36 characters like 6F9619FF-8B86-D011-B42D-00C04FC964FF.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:ImporteNoPositivo: The amount must be greater than zero.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:SoloLoACreditoSeSalda: Only a credit purchase or sale can be marked as paid.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:EvidenciaVacia: Evidence needs a file, an explanation, or both.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:SolicitudSinConceptos: An invoice has 1 to 50 line items.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:ConceptoNoValido: Check the item «{concepto}»: 8-digit SAT code, description, unit, quantity and price above zero, and VAT of 16%, 8%, 0% or exempt.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:SolicitudYaAtendida: This request is no longer pending.
Texts.Tipos:Intro: When you create a user you pick a type and they get these roles. From then on roles are what matter: the type is just the starting template.
Texts.Tipos:SoloAnade: Only adds roles. Never removes ones set by hand.
Texts.Tipos:RolesDeLaPlantilla: Roles given to users created with this type
Texts.Tipos:EmptyHint: A type groups the roles a new user receives. Without types, roles are assigned one by one.
Texts.Tipos:Sugerencia: The “{0}” module suggests these types and they don't exist yet:
Texts.Tipos:SugerenciaAviso: Missing roles will be created with no permissions: who can do what is your call.
Texts.Tipos:SugerenciasHechas: {0} types created and {1} new roles (no permissions yet).
Texts.Feature:Cuota:MaxUsuarios:Desc: How many users this organization can have. 0 = unlimited.
Texts.Feature:Cuota:MaxClavesDeApi:Desc: Keys active at once; revoked and expired ones do not count. 0 = unlimited.
Texts.Cuota:Alcanzada: This organization has reached its limit of {0} ({1}). Revoke or delete one, or ask for the limit to be raised.
Texts.Cuota:SinEspacio: This organization is out of storage (limit: {0} MB). Delete files you no longer need, or ask for the limit to be raised.
Texts.Purga:SoloDesdeElHost: This operation can only be performed from the installation panel.
Texts.Purga:NombreNoCoincide: The name does not match. Type exactly “{0}” to confirm.
Texts.Importar:DemasiadoGrande: The file is larger than {0} MB.
Texts.Importar:YaExiste: “{0}” already exists. Tick “update existing” to change it.
Texts.Purga:Aviso: This permanently deletes all data for “{0}”. It cannot be undone.
Texts.Purga:Lista2: Its data, files, API keys and notifications.
Texts.Purga:Lista3: Its branding, contracted modules and audit history.
Texts.Purga:ErrorGenerico: The deletion could not be completed.
Texts.Importar:Intro: Upload a CSV with your catalogue. Columns are matched by name, so their order does not matter.
Texts.Importar:Columnas: Name and Price are required; Stock is optional.
Texts.Importar:Actualizar: Update products that already exist (by name)
Texts.Importar:NoValido: The columns were not recognised. The file needs at least a “Name” and a “Price” column.
Texts.Importar:Error: The file could not be processed.
Texts.Importar:NombreLargo: The name is longer than {0} characters.
Texts.Importar:Duplicado: “{0}” already appears earlier in the file.
Texts.Importar:PrecioInvalido: The price “{0}” is not a valid number.
Texts.Importar:StockInvalido: The stock “{0}” is not a valid whole number.
Texts.Feature:Catalogo:Desc: Product creation, sales report and CSV import.
Texts.Audit:Intro: What was requested and what changed. The request log says which endpoint was called; the history says which field changed and from what to what.
Texts.Alertas:Intro: Where alerts are sent when something goes out of range.
Texts.Alertas:ErrorEstado: Could not change the alert state.
Texts.Cuenta:AccesoAnteriorPista: If you don't recognise this, change your password.
Texts.Cuenta:ContrasenaPie: Change it if you suspect someone else knows it.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:TelefonoSinCodigoDePais: The phone number "{telefono}" has no country code. Write it in full, for example +52 55 1234 5678.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:InvitacionCerrada: This invitation is no longer valid: it was accepted, revoked or it expired. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:InvitacionNoValida: The invitation link is not valid or was already used. Ask whoever invited you for a new one.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:InvitacionYaPendiente: There is already a pending invitation for {email}. Resend it from the list instead of creating another one.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:InvitacionCorreoConCuen: An account with the email {email} already exists.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:AvisoDePrivacidadDesact: To continue you have to accept the current privacy notice. If the page was open for a while, reload it: the notice changed.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:DocumentoDemasiadoGrand: The file is larger than {max} MB.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:DocumentoTipoNoAdmitido: That file type is not accepted here.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:EstadoDeCuentaNoCuadra: The bank statement does not balance (difference: {diferencia}).
Texts.AuxiliarContable:MovimientoNegativo: Debits and credits must not be negative.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:DocumentoInfectado: The antivirus flagged this file and it was not saved.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:CampoDelPerfilDesconoci: The field «{campo}» does not exist in the profile.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:DatoDelPerfilNoExiste: That field has no value to confirm yet.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:InvitacionRolFueraDeAlc: You cannot invite someone with that role.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:InvitacionDemasiadosEnv: This invitation was already sent {maximo} times. Revoke it and create a new one if needed.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:InvitacionCorreoNoConfi: Email sending is not configured yet, so the invitation cannot go out. Ask the Developer to configure Brevo.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:CodigoIncorrecto: The code is wrong or has expired. Check it or request a new one.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:CodigoEsperaEntreEnvios: Wait {segundos} seconds before requesting another code.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:CodigoDemasiadosEnvios: You already requested several codes in the last hour. Try again later.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:CodigoDemasiadosFallos: Too many wrong codes. Wait {minutos} minutes and try again.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:SmsNoDisponible: SMS sending is not active yet. Save your number and it will be verified once it is.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:SegundoFactorSinMetodo: To turn on two-step verification, first verify your email (or link Telegram).
Texts.AuxiliarContable:RecuperacionSinSegundoF: Recovery codes are for two-step verification: turn it on first.
Texts.Permission:Organizaciones: Organizations: create them and assign stations and people
Texts.AuxiliarContable:OrganizacionObligatoria: A client user (User role) must join an organization: choose one.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:OrganizacionNoExiste: The chosen organization no longer exists. Reload and choose another.
Texts.AuxiliarContable:InvitacionSinOrganizaci: This invitation's organization no longer exists. Ask for a new invitation.
